sub_question: SQ5: Data architecture/telemetry & integrations enabling the agent (+ SQ6 sensor-accuracy caveat)
summary: A 7-layer pipeline: (1) sensing (optical PM, electrochemical gases, NDIR CO2 + T/RH); (2) a MANDATORY edge/cloud CORRECTION layer (RH/T compensation + model-based calibration vs reference) — without it low-cost PM2.5 has MAE ~17 µg/m³, larger than the WHO 24h limit itself; (3) timestamped telemetry ingest (MQTT/HTTP) with device+location metadata; (4) context fusion (GPS microenvironment, physical-activity for inhaled dose, symptom/med log); (5) time-series storage; (6) reasoning (NowCast/AQI compute, threshold engine, forecast-API ingest, LLM agent); (7) interop output (JSON schema, FHIR for clinician/EHR, API, alerts).
key_insight: The calibration layer is load-bearing, not optional garnish: peer-reviewed work shows uncalibrated low-cost PM2.5 MAE ~17.40 µg/m³ dropping to ~5.85 after model-based correction (~3x), and humidity is the dominant confounder for optical PM sensors (they read swelled hygroscopic particles as more mass). PurpleAir needs a US-EPA correction factor (~3.4 / national equation). If the agent reasons on raw uncorrected data it will systematically OVER-warn in humid conditions and mis-time advice — so the architecture must place RH-aware calibration BEFORE any AQI computation or agent inference, and must attach a data-quality/confidence flag that the agent surfaces to the user.

2_correction_QA: model-based calibration vs reference-grade (linear correction factor → ML/ensemble)
3_telemetry: record = {ts, device_id, lat/lon, per-pollutant conc, T/RH, quality_flag}
4_context_fusion: physical-activity from wearable/phone → breathing-rate for inhaled dose (ADD)
user profile: condition, meds, symptom log
6_reasoning: LLM agent for advice + symptom correlation
7_interop: machine-readable JSON/CSV schema for the agent
FHIR Observation resources for clinician/EHR sharing

detail.sensor_accuracy_caveat_SQ6: Uncalibrated LCS unreliable: MAE 17.40→5.85 µg/m³ after ML calibration; RH is main confounder; requires periodic co-location/drift correction. Agent must communicate uncertainty, not present raw LCS as reference-grade.

notes: Calibration numbers (MAE 17.40→5.85; PurpleAir CF ~3.4; RH confounding; multi-stage/ML frameworks) corroborated across 4 peer-reviewed sources → strong, and this doubles as the core of SQ6's sensor-accuracy caveat. The 7-layer architecture is organized synthesis on top. FHIR/OpenAQ integration named but not deeply verified — adequate for design-level answer.
